scope: Standalone development SCCP analysis -> owned rewrite -> incremental scalar fold/CSE/DCE orchestration. Not enabled in Coil; not full ir_iter_opt parity.
design: One analysis and one bulk transformation; no repeated whole-SCCP loop.

Rewritten owns an iteration queue. One linear comparison of original instruction starts and complete operands transfers changed nodes, original users, former/new inputs, and analyzer iteration candidates.
Fresh use lists are built after bulk rewriting; the iterative kernel updates these in place. No second graph duplication is made by the orchestrator.

Caller graph and roots remain immutable. Owned facts are released before iterative cleanup; result release also releases its queue. Downstream CFG/dominance/placement/scheduling/matching must be rebuilt.
evidence: Before iterative cleanup, a simplified Phi exposes two identical ADD instructions; the latter ADD is queued. Cleanup replaces the observable latter ADD with COPY of the first.
25 original JIT and 25 optimized JIT known answers, plus 25 linked AOT answers, all equal twice the sum of their arguments.
Optimized graph is released before image mapping. Source duplicate and branch remain unchanged.
Second complete optimization reports zero edits.
A six-input Phi edited only in its continuation cell queues the Phi, original user and former/new inputs. Analyzer candidates are copied without consumption; an unrelated node stays unqueued.
